description: This file defines the MailStatsLocation class, which extends LocationItem and manages mail statistics location data within the Goteo project. It includes methods for construction and retrieval based on MailStats objects or IDs.

classes.name: MailStatsLocation
classes.description: A class representing mail statistics location data, extending LocationItem, with custom constructor and static get method.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a MailStatsLocation object and sets the mail_stats property based on the object's ID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a MailStatsLocation instance by MailStats object or ID.
